title: At the prime-scale shift endpoint both separator corners stay positive (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `theta=1/1444`, `alpha=3`, `gamma=9*pi*1445/1444`, and `beta0=-1/2`, the bandwidth-2 truncation keeps both Schur directions between vertices 1 and 8 positive. The forward corner lies strictly between `1/10^50` and `1/10^49`. The reverse corner lies strictly between `1/10^222` and `1/10^221`. The half-bandwidth is 3.
- `s=722/1445=1/(2 rho)` is the closed endpoint of the gauge-free shift range and still satisfies `|beta0/rho|<1/2`. Every off-diagonal row sum of this truncation is below `99/100`, so its own row gap exceeds `1/(16 p^2)`. That does not check `||N-I||_infinity <= exp(-2 a theta)+5 exp(-2a)` for the gauged matrix.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one prime, one shift endpoint, and width 2, not the all-size bandwidth claim.
